# External Data Directory

This directory contains external reference datasets, manual dumps, and publicly available static files.

## External Data Sources

Here are the key external data sources with their URLs used for AUTOVAULT AI:

- **Government & Economic Data:**
  - [data.gov.in](https://data.gov.in) - Open Government Data Platform India (useful for inflation, RTO data)
  - [vahan.parivahan.gov.in](https://vahan.parivahan.gov.in) - Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (vehicle registration statistics)
  - [siam.in](https://www.siam.in) - Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (industry reports and sales data)
  - [ppac.gov.in](https://www.ppac.gov.in) - Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (historical fuel prices)

- **Battery Degradation Datasets:**
  - [NASA battery dataset](https://ti.arc.nasa.gov/tech/dash/groups/pcoe/prognostic-data-repository/) - Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
  - [CALCE battery dataset](https://calce.umd.edu/battery-data) - Center for Advanced Life Cycle Engineering battery data

- **Automotive Portals (Scraping Targets):**
  - [Cars24](https://www.cars24.com) - Used car pricing and availability
  - [CarDekho](https://www.cardekho.com) - New/used car specifications and prices
  - [CarWale](https://www.carwale.com) - Vehicle valuations and reviews
